'''Geniserian sand monkeys''' were a rare [[Monkey/Legends|monkey]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Geniseria system/Legends|Geniseria system]] that had physical similarities to the [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] species. The meat of a Geniserian sand monkey was considered a delicacy by some individuals when it was flambéed in [[foyvè oil]]. [[Jorrk]], an associate of the Nimbanel criminal [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]], nicknamed the Nimbanel "Monkey Jabba" due to his similarity in appearance to the Geniserian sand monkey and Binneed's occasional impersonations of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] for whom Binneed worked.

==Biology and appearance==
The Geniserian sand [[Monkey/Legends|monkey]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had some similarities in appearance to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] species.<ref name="Kenobi" />

==History==
A rare species, Geniserian sand monkeys were<ref name="Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> native to the [[Geniseria system/Legends|Geniseria system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Geniserian sand monkeys in the galaxy==
Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="KenobiDate">{{Facebook|username=people/Star-Wars-Books/100064411132431|url=photo.php?fbid=10151201849798713&set=a.414408798712.177165.67519418712&type=1&relevant_count=1|name=Star Wars Books|date=October 12|archivedate=20160411033308}} &mdash; This post stated that the events of [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']] occurred after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Jorrk]], an associate of a Nimbanel criminal named [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]] who was working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], had seen a Geniserian sand monkey once. Due to Binneed's Nimbanel appearance and the instances when he pretended to be Jabba to confuse competitors, Jorrk nicknamed Binneed "Monkey Jabba," which Jorrk found to be funny.<ref name="Kenobi" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Geniserian sand monkey meat flambéed in [[foyvè oil]] was a rare dish that was considered a delicacy by some individuals. Despite the rarity of the species around that [[Time/Legends|time]], an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] named [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] successfully obtained a dish of Geniserian sand monkey meat flambéed in foyvè [[Oil/Legends|oil]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The Elomin provided the dish to satisfy the epicurean tastes of a [[Unidentified individual (Jax Pavan client 1)|client]] of a private [[Detective/Legends|investigator]] named [[Jax Pavan]], with whom Rhinann worked.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Geniserian sand monkey was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />
